coders.name: Johnson9
coders.note: Coded in a Claude Code chat that showed only the sheet rule, the sheet rows and the rubric clarification below. Before coding, the chat gave a neutral explanation of the sheet rule, from the sheet text only, that listed the points the sheet does not define. Before coding any run, the coder received a written rubric clarification (2026-11-03, settled and open points from docs/injection-protocol.md, Labels) and then a correction of it the same day that limits borderline to OWASP-label ambiguity and withdraws a coverage-based way of choosing the effect chain. Coder 2 gets the corrected text unchanged (artifacts/stage2/qwen3.8-flash/rubric-clarification.md). The chat first showed runs one at a time. The coder answered runs 1 to 5 that way (the run 1 note declared ChatGPT assistance), then asked to start over, and those answers were discarded. The chat then showed the rule, the corrected clarification and all 33 runs at once, and the coder gave the answers below. The coder said they did not use ChatGPT or another AI tool for these answers. The coder said they had not opened report.json, report.md, hand-checks.json, traces.jsonl or another coder file.
